name: E-Ink Launcher
tagline: A home screen launcher made for e-ink and e-reader screens
description:
E-Ink Launcher is designed specifically for Android devices with electronic paper displays, like e-readers, giving you a simple, high-contrast home screen that works well with the slower refresh rates and unique look of e-ink screens.

If you use an Android-based e-reader or e-ink tablet, this launcher is built to fit that experience rather than being a regular phone launcher squeezed onto e-ink hardware.
